metadata.title: ORION — Digital Systems for Ambitious Businesses
metadata.description: Digital transformation studio based in Benin. We build high-performance websites, custom business software, and AI automation systems to elevate your business.

hero.subtitle: Beyond traditional websites: we craft high-velocity web platforms, bespoke business applications, and AI automations that scale your operations and drive measurable ROI.

problem.title: A passive website is no longer enough to dominate your market
problem.subtitle: Modern companies lose valuable prospects daily due to sluggish tools, disjointed manual processes, and zero intelligence integration.
problem.card1Desc: Clunky pages that fail to convert high-intent visitors and dilute your brand authority.
problem.card2Desc: Hours wasted copying chats, scattered spreadsheets, and missed customer follow-ups.
problem.card3Desc: Rigid software that forces your team to adapt to its constraints instead of serving your business.

divisions.title: End-to-end expertise for every stage of your growth
divisions.subtitle: From high-converting brand platforms to intelligent operating software.

web.name: WEB
web.desc: Ultra-fast showcase websites, obsidian visual elegance, and compelling storytelling engineered to cement your authority and capture high-value clients.

business.name: BUSINESS
business.desc: Scalable web ecosystems equipped with lightweight headless CMS, high-ranking blogs, and seamless analytics & marketing integrations.

systems.name: SYSTEMS
systems.desc: Bespoke operational web apps tailored to digitize your core workflows: booking engines, client dashboards, CRMs, and internal business tools.

ai.name: AI & AUTOMATION
ai.desc: Intelligent conversational bots, 24/7 lead qualification assistants, automated WhatsApp flows, and backend workflow integrations.

care.title: ORION CARE — Your digital infrastructure on 24/7 autopilot
care.subtitle: A continuous partnership ensuring your systems remain secure, fast, and continuously evolving alongside your business.
care.plan1Desc: High-availability managed hosting, automated daily backups, and critical security patches.
care.plan2Desc: Everything in Essential + performance monitoring, monthly SEO audits, and priority support.
care.plan3Desc: Everything in Growth + dedicated monthly product iteration hours and continuous AI upgrades.

method.title: A 4-step surgical execution process
method.subtitle: No endless meetings or vague promises: just a transparent, battle-tested framework.
method.step1Desc: In-depth audit of your business model, identifying friction points, and locking precise technical blueprints.
method.step2Desc: Crafting bespoke UI/UX, validating user journeys, and structuring high-performance databases.
method.step3Desc: Clean code with Next.js, Supabase, and Tailwind. Performance, security, and accessibility testing.
method.step4Desc: Live edge deployment on Vercel, team handover, and activation of ORION CARE maintenance.

work.title: Measurable impact for ambitious leaders
work.subtitle: Explore how we turned complex operational hurdles into strategic competitive advantages.
work.case1Problem: Phone booking gridlock, patient record scatter, and high appointment no-show rates.
work.case1Solution: HIPAA-grade web portal with instant online booking, automated SMS/WhatsApp reminders, and practitioner dashboards.
work.case1Result: +140% online reservations, 65% drop in unanswered front-desk calls.
work.case2Problem: Leads lost overnight, manual quote generation taking over 24 hours.
work.case2Solution: Autonomous AI assistant on WhatsApp & Web capturing freight specs and instantly notifying sales reps.
work.case2Result: First-response latency dropped from 4 hours to 8 seconds; quote conversions up 48%.
work.case3Problem: Outdated web presence failing to reflect high academic prestige; paper-based enrollment bottlenecks.
work.case3Solution: Bilingual showcase platform featuring interactive virtual tours and digital pre-registration modules.

about.title: Building beyond conventional limits
about.subtitle: ORION was created on one clear conviction: ambitious companies across Africa and worldwide deserve world-class digital systems.
about.storyP1: Founded by BK Global Technologies in Cotonou, Benin, ORION unites rigorous software engineering, obsidian aesthetics, and applied artificial intelligence.
about.storyP2: We don't just ship code: we build high-leverage strategic assets that embed into your core operations and generate tangible ROI from day one.
about.value1Desc: Every line of code is optimized for velocity, robustness, and bulletproof security.
about.value2Desc: Technology is a vehicle: your revenue growth and efficiency are our true north.
about.value3Desc: Crisp milestones, clear communication, and zero technical jargon.

contact.title: Ready to scale your business into the next dimension?
